# Remaining-research evidence index

Access date: 2026-10-18. The [source-register index](../../03_research-rounds/00_orientation-and-baseline/runs/2026-10-18-remaining-research/sources.md) points to five workstream registers and the two earlier research runs. Registers include publication/version information where available, actual inspection scope and access limitations.

| Register | Local source IDs |
| --- | --- |
| [Product and market](../../03_research-rounds/00_orientation-and-baseline/runs/2026-10-18-remaining-research/product-market.md) | PM01–PM12 |
| [UX and accessibility](../../03_research-rounds/00_orientation-and-baseline/runs/2026-10-18-remaining-research/ux-and-accessibility.md) | U01–U10 |
| [Development method](../../03_research-rounds/00_orientation-and-baseline/runs/2026-10-18-remaining-research/development-method.md) | D01–D10 |
| [Technical and responsible AI](../../03_research-rounds/00_orientation-and-baseline/runs/2026-10-18-remaining-research/technical-and-responsible-ai.md) | S01–S10 |
| [Codex and GitHub](../../03_research-rounds/00_orientation-and-baseline/runs/2026-10-18-remaining-research/codex-and-delivery.md) | C01–C07 |

These are source **groups**, not a count of unique pages or independent studies. Some groups contain several related pages, some sources recur across runs, and an official source's claim still has a limited scope. Avoid counting linked pages as independent corroboration.

[Independent reviews](../../03_research-rounds/00_orientation-and-baseline/runs/2026-10-18-remaining-research/review.md) sampled material claims and documented corrections; not every citation was independently rechecked. No full articles, private resumes or raw personal-workspace documents were copied here.
